name: Kemba, Kha Regent
description: A leonin kha who wants to rebuild Taj-Nar for those who remain.

description_citations.text: Commander Masters: card flavor text (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The leonin lose their leader Raksha and split into two prides, one supporting the regent kha and one rebelling.
timeline.quote: Left without their leader Raksha, the leonin split into two prides
